posts.en:
windows-bash is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Makes Git Bash the only terminal tool for DeepSeek Harness on Windows: enables the bash executor and tool, disables PowerShell everywhere, and ships standard/code/cordis bash-only agent presets with the full-access sandbox defaults Git Bash's cygwin runtime needs.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dfff02b29b1736b10d78.html
